name: harmonia
description: Single source of truth for Harmonia v3 presets, shared by the plugin (Harmonia-APP), the backend and the AI. Generated from it: the C++ parameter table and JUCE layout of the plugin (scripts/v3/charter_cpp.py) and the Python parameter specs (src/charter_v3.py, src/synth/v3_params.py). Edit this file, never the generated ones.
versioning: Major: an id is renamed or removed, or a value changes meaning (needs upgrade rules). Minor: new parameters whose default leaves existing presets unchanged. Patch: labels, descriptions, documentation.

normalization.description: Presets carry every value normalized to [0, 1], as plugin hosts do; the curves below are those of juce::NormalisableRange, so the plugin and the AI read a value the same way.
normalization.snap: clamp v to [min, max], then round exactly as the plugin's JUCE parameters do: int and choice to the nearest integer, halves to the even one (juce::roundToInt: 8.5 -> 8, 2.5 -> 2); bool: max when v - min >= half the range, else min (juce::AudioParameterBool); float with step > 0: min + step * floor((v - min) / step + 0.5)
normalization.skew: 1 without centre; log(0.5) / log((centre - min) / (max - min)) with a centre: that value sits at 0.5 (juce::NormalisableRange::setSkewForCentre)
normalization.to_normalized: p = (snap(v) - min) / (max - min); n = p ^ skew
normalization.from_normalized: p = clamp(n, 0, 1) ^ (1 / skew); v = snap(min + (max - min) * p)
normalization.choices: a choice or bool parameter holds the index of its choice: i of n <-> i / (n - 1)

global.label: Engine
global.description: Which engine plays the preset: the analog engine or the DX7 FM engine.

analog.label: Analog
analog.reference: src/synth/engine_v3.py (reference implementation for the C++ port): per voice 2 oscillators x unison + noise -> filter -> drive -> amplifier, at twice the sample rate; then chorus -> delay -> reverb.
analog.order: The order of `parameters` is the order of the AI's vectors (src/synth/v3_params.py, src/v3/codecs.py): never reorder, append only.

parameters.label: Osc 1 Wave
parameters.description: Oscillator 1 shape; saw and pulse are band-limited (PolyBLEP).

parameters.label: Osc 2 Wave
parameters.description: Oscillator 2 shape; saw and pulse are band-limited (PolyBLEP).

parameters.label: Osc Mix
parameters.description: Crossfade from oscillator 1 (0) to oscillator 2 (1).

parameters.label: Osc 2 Detune
parameters.description: Oscillator 2 tuned this many cents above oscillator 1.

parameters.label: Noise
parameters.description: White noise crossfaded with the oscillators (1 = noise only).

parameters.label: Cutoff
parameters.description: Filter cutoff before modulation (envelope, LFO, velocity, keyboard).

parameters.label: Resonance
parameters.description: Filter resonance: Q = 0.707 x 17^(resonance / 0.95) (Harmonia-App#40 mapping).

parameters.label: Filter Type
parameters.description: State-variable filter output (juce::dsp::StateVariableTPTFilter).

parameters.label: Attack
parameters.description: Amplitude envelope attack (linear rise to full level).

parameters.label: Decay
parameters.description: Amplitude envelope decay to the sustain level (exponential, -80 dB of the distance at this time).

parameters.label: Sustain
parameters.description: Amplitude level held while the key is down.

parameters.label: Release
parameters.description: Amplitude release after note-off (exponential, -80 dB at this time).

parameters.label: Filter Env Amount
parameters.description: Filter envelope depth in octaves at full envelope (negative closes the filter).

parameters.label: Filter Env Decay
parameters.description: Filter envelope decay to its sustain level (exponential).

parameters.label: LFO Rate
parameters.description: LFO frequency.

parameters.label: LFO to Pitch
parameters.description: Vibrato: LFO to the pitch of every oscillator, in cents at full LFO.

parameters.label: LFO to Cutoff
parameters.description: LFO to the filter cutoff, in octaves at full LFO.

parameters.label: Velocity to Cutoff
parameters.description: Velocity to cutoff: at 1, from -2 octaves (softest note) to +2 octaves (hardest).

parameters.label: Drive
parameters.description: Soft clipping after the filter (tanh, drive 1 + 12 x mix) mixed with the clean signal.

parameters.label: Reverb Mix
parameters.description: Reverb wet level; the dry level is 1 - 0.7 x mix (v2 law).

parameters.label: Osc 1 Coarse
parameters.description: Oscillator 1 transposition.

parameters.label: Osc 2 Coarse
parameters.description: Oscillator 2 transposition.

parameters.label: Pulse Width
parameters.description: Width of the pulse wave of both oscillators.

parameters.label: Sync
parameters.description: Hard sync: oscillator 2 restarts with each cycle of oscillator 1.

parameters.label: Cross Mod
parameters.description: Cross-modulation as on the OB-X: oscillator 1 bends oscillator 2's pitch by this many semitones per unit.

parameters.label: Ring Mod
parameters.description: Ring modulation (osc 1 x osc 2) crossfaded in place of the oscillator mix.

parameters.label: Unison Voices
parameters.description: Number of stacked voices per note.

parameters.label: Unison Detune
parameters.description: Unison voices are spread evenly from -detune to +detune cents.

parameters.label: Filter Slope
parameters.description: One (12 dB/octave) or two (24 dB/octave) filter stages.

parameters.label: Key Tracking
parameters.description: Cutoff follows the keyboard: at 1, one octave per octave around C4 (MIDI 60).

parameters.label: Filter Env Attack
parameters.description: Filter envelope attack (linear).

parameters.label: Filter Env Sustain
parameters.description: Filter envelope level held while the key is down.

parameters.label: Filter Env Release
parameters.description: Filter envelope release after note-off (exponential).

parameters.label: Velocity to Level
parameters.description: 0: every note at full level; 1: level proportional to velocity.

parameters.label: Pitch Env Amount
parameters.description: Pitch offset at note-on, decaying to 0.

parameters.label: Pitch Env Decay
parameters.description: Pitch envelope decay (exp(-5 t / decay): 0.7 % of the offset left at this time).

parameters.label: LFO Wave
parameters.description: LFO shape (sample & hold draws a new random value each cycle).

parameters.label: LFO Delay
parameters.description: LFO fades in linearly over this time after note-on.

parameters.label: LFO to Level
parameters.description: Tremolo: at 1 the level dips to 0 at the LFO's lowest point.

parameters.label: LFO to Pulse Width
parameters.description: LFO to pulse width: at 1, +/- 0.45.

parameters.label: Chorus
parameters.description: Juno-style stereo chorus (0.5 Hz, 3.5 +/- 1.75 ms, opposite phases): wet share.

parameters.label: Delay Time
parameters.description: Echo time.

parameters.label: Delay Feedback
parameters.description: Share of each echo fed back (low-passed at 6 kHz).

parameters.label: Delay Mix
parameters.description: Echo level added to the dry signal.

parameters.label: Reverb Size
parameters.description: Reverb decay: T60 = 0.3 + 11.7 x size^2 seconds (feedback delay network).

parameters.label: Stereo Width
parameters.description: Spread of the unison voices, and of osc 1 (left) / osc 2 (right), across the stereo field.

dx7.label: DX7
dx7.reference: native/dx7: Dexed's msfa FM core (Apache-2.0). A preset is one DX7 voice (VCED single-voice layout); operators[0] is OP1 (the VCED buffer stores OP6 first).
dx7.id_pattern: operator field: dx7_op{n}_{id} (n = 1..6); voice field: dx7_{id}; {k} = 1..4 for the four envelope stages
dx7.order: OP1..OP6 (operator fields in this order), then voice fields: the order of src/v3/codecs.py.

operator_fields.label: EG Rate {k}
operator_fields.description: Envelope generator rate of stage {k} (99 = fastest).

operator_fields.label: EG Level {k}
operator_fields.description: Envelope generator level reached at the end of stage {k}.

operator_fields.label: Break Point
operator_fields.description: Keyboard level scaling break point (0 = A-1, 39 = C3, 99 = C8).

operator_fields.label: Left Depth
operator_fields.description: Level scaling depth below the break point.

operator_fields.label: Right Depth
operator_fields.description: Level scaling depth above the break point.

operator_fields.label: Left Curve
operator_fields.description: Level scaling curve below the break point.

operator_fields.label: Right Curve
operator_fields.description: Level scaling curve above the break point.

operator_fields.label: Rate Scaling
operator_fields.description: Envelope rates speed up for higher keys.

operator_fields.label: Amp Mod Sens
operator_fields.description: Sensitivity of this operator to LFO amplitude modulation.

operator_fields.label: Output Level
operator_fields.description: Operator output level (carrier volume or modulation index).

operator_fields.label: Osc Mode
operator_fields.description: Frequency as a ratio of the key, or fixed.

operator_fields.label: Coarse
operator_fields.description: Frequency ratio (0 = 0.5) or fixed frequency range.

voice_fields.label: Pitch EG Level {k}
voice_fields.description: Pitch envelope level of stage {k} (50 = no shift).

voice_fields.label: Algorithm
voice_fields.description: How the six operators modulate each other, shown 1..32.

voice_fields.label: Feedback
voice_fields.description: Self-modulation of the algorithm's feedback operator.

voice_fields.label: Osc Key Sync
voice_fields.description: Operators restart their phase at each note.

voice_fields.label: LFO Amp Depth
voice_fields.description: LFO to operator levels (tremolo / wah, see amp_mod_sens).

voice_fields.label: Pitch Mod Sens
voice_fields.description: Sensitivity of the pitch to the LFO.

voice_fields.label: Transpose
voice_fields.description: Transposition in semitones, shown -24..+24 (24 = C3, none).

v2_upgrade.description: A v2 preset or plugin state (20 parameters, src/synth/params.py / Harmonia-APP before v3) becomes v3 per analog parameter: v3 = offset + scale * v2[from], on physical values (a JUCE state stores physical values). Parameters without a rule take their default; the engine is analog.

preset_format.parameters: object: parameter id -> normalized value in [0, 1]. Holds `engine` and the parameters of that engine; the other engine's parameters are ignored; a missing parameter takes its default.
preset_format.brief: optional: the sound brief the preset was made from (sound_brief)
preset_format.compatibility: Same shape as v1/v2 (metadata + parameters), so the backend's PresetCharterSchema and the plugin's PresetLoader keep working; `engine` is a parameter so that it survives the backend unchanged.

sound_brief.status: draft (v0.1): to be validated by listening before any model is trained on it
sound_brief.description: What a prompt asks for, in words a model can check on a sound: the step between the text and the parameters. For a real preset it is read from its human labels and measured on its rendered sound (C3, velocity 100/127, 1.5 s held, 4 s); for a prompt it is filled from the text. Bins are quantiles of the measure over the real presets of the bank, so every word covers a known share of real sounds; no threshold is invented.

fields.source: human labels (preset categories and names, FSD50K classes) through src/v3/vocabulary.py; for a sound without a label, the synth space's type head

fields.measure: time from note-on to 90 % of the peak of the RMS envelope (10 ms windows)
spectral centroid over the held part divided by the note's fundamental
sustained when the level at the end of the hold is within 12 dB of the peak; otherwise the time from the peak to -30 dB
depth: standard deviation over time of the 1/3-octave band levels while held; rate: dominant frequency of that variation
fields.bins: static = lower half by depth; slow / fast split at the median rate of the others
mono = no side energy (below -40 dB); narrow / wide split at the median of the others

fields.measure: tail: time to fall 30 dB after note-off, minus the same with reverb and delay off
fields.bins: dry = under 50 ms; room / hall split at the median of the others

fields.values: free list of names (instrument, synth, artist, era)
fields.source: matched against the human names, categories and comments of real presets (src/presets/labels.py); never measured
preferred engine, when the text implies one (e.g. FM, DX7)
